ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: The following figure is a solar apparent motion diagram for locations a and b on the Northern Hemisphere summer solstice. Based on this, answer: <image1> Among locations a and b, what is the latitude of location a?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The vertical axis in the figure is labeled H (solar altitude angle), with scale marks of 0°, 10°, 20°, and 30°; the horizontal axis is T (time), marked with times such as 6, 12, 18, and 24. Curve a reaches its highest near noon, and the maximum solar altitude is read from the figure as about 30°. Also, the curve does not fall below 0° throughout the day, indicating that location a has polar day on the summer solstice. Then reason: On the Northern Hemisphere summer solstice, the solar declination δ=23°26′N. The noon solar altitude formula is H=90°−|φ−δ|. Location a is at high latitude in the Northern Hemisphere and has polar day, so take φ>δ. Thus 30°=90°−(φ−23°26′), so φ=90°+23°26′−30°=83°26′N.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中横轴为时间T，纵轴为太阳高度H，a曲线在正午附近达到最高，最高太阳高度读为30°，且全天不落到0°以下。再结合题干“北半球夏至日”，取太阳赤纬δ=23°26′N，用正午太阳高度公式H=90°−|φ−δ|；由于a地处北半球高纬、发生极昼，取φ>δ的解，得φ=90°+23°26′−30°=83°26′N。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中纵轴标注为H（太阳高度角），刻度有0°、10°、20°、30°；横轴为T（时间），标有6、12、18、24等时刻。a曲线在正午附近达到最高，最高太阳高度从图上读为约30°，并且全天曲线没有降到0°以下，表示夏至日a地出现极昼现象。再推理：北半球夏至日太阳赤纬δ=23°26′N。正午太阳高度公式为H=90°−|φ−δ|。a地在北半球高纬且发生极昼，取φ>δ，则30°=90°−(φ−23°26′)，所以φ=90°+23°26′−30°=83°26′N。
